name: Shinomiya Yuzuka
source: An innocent housewife with a cute face and nice body. She used to work in the same company as the protagonist, through that affinity she started dating and marry the protagonist. While she was still working in the company,  she has been acquainted with Ryuichi before her marriage with Hiroaki. She is a secret fan of Ryuichi's written articles.
